returnInterest.note: I would like to return for a road trip and to explore more of Sweden's nature.

description.intro: Sweden is a Scandinavian country known for its forests, lakes, northern landscapes, music exports, and global brands such as IKEA. I unfortunately did not get the chance to explore much of the country during my visit. Even though I was sick and visited during a cold winter period, I still enjoyed my time there thanks to the beauty of the capital.
personalNotes: I did not get the chance to explore much of the country.
I was very sick during my visit.
I would like to return in the future to see more of the country's nature.

travelPracticalities.visaNotes: I did not need a visa.
paymentNotes: Paying by card seemed to be the most common method.
I believe cash was usually accepted as well.
transportNotes: There pretty cheap busses you can take for long distances between cities.
There is also an extensive train network, but I did not use it.
languageNotes: The sole official language is Swedish.
The level of English in Sweden is very good.

notes: It was quite cold during my visit.
